name: Barbarian audit: Crusher resets Crush's cooldown from a native DBC-generated proc, no code needed (#1257)
contract: Crusher rank 2 (807875) has native DBC ProcFlags 4, ProcChance 20, and aura 42 triggering cooldown reset
807911 for Crush 500915. No spell_proc row is needed because the nonzero original flags generate its
native proc. Waiting for Crush's 25-second cooldown to reach zero can accept ordinary expiry after only
about thirteen swings, leaving an unnecessary 5 percent chance that no actual proc occurred. Twenty
independent windows each fund and cast Crush normally after a fixture cooldown reset, stop melee until the
native cooldown is at least 24 seconds, then allow sixteen seconds of ordinary 1900 ms sword attacks.
Native proc counters and cooldowns are recorded every two seconds while ordinary expiry is still
impossible. Require twenty accepted normal Crush casts and at least 100 actual melee damage events,
preserve the original 20 percent chance and attack speed, and independently require an observed native
proc paired with a zero cooldown inside a window. Fixture cooldown resets happen before each new normal
cast and cannot satisfy the measured reset contract.
